name: GREEN DEMON
author: - (nano4618)
description: Jump over the last spike and pink pad at 22% and then buffer the following pink orb and one more jump after to jump over the yellow pad and fall to the floor at 23%. Stay on the floor until 62% where you can start holding when your icon is under the normal gravity portal to be able to hit the pink pad at 63% and then time the yellow orb making it so you reenter the level through the ship portal at 64%. Play the rest of the level normally from there.
